news.title: ⏱️ Time to Rogue is now on iPhone!
news.message: Time to Rogue is a roguelike played in glances throughout your day. Focus recovers over real-world hours, and the dungeon hunts while you're away. Play the full game free on iPhone or Apple Watch: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/time-to-rogue/id6786902468

news.title: 🎵 New: Music & Sound!
news.message: The dungeon now has a soundtrack! Featuring original music by Lazarus D. Richardson. Listen to the full album at https://lazarusrichardson.bandcamp.com/album/gravesweeper

news.title: 🖥️ Now on Windows & Mac!
news.message: Gravesweeper is now available for desktop! Play on Windows or Mac for just $4 at https://superwes.itch.io/gravesweeper — bigger screen, same spooky fun!

news.title: 💣 Trap Counter Now Shows Progress
news.message: The Trap Counter upgrade now displays how many gravestones you've placed vs total traps (e.g., '💣 12/45'). The counter turns green when you've marked all traps! This helps you track your progress and know when you've found everything.

news.title: ✨ Quality of Life Improvements
news.message: We've added several small improvements based on your feedback: haptic feedback when placing markers, improved animations, and a few lower prices in the shop. The game should feel more polished overall!

news.title: Did you know?
news.message: The initial version of Gravesweeper was designed, developed, and released in under two weeks by one person? If you also want to be inspired and motivated, find a local community like the one in St. Louis. Check out https://stlgame.dev for information about the St. Louis Game Development community!

tips: Buy Swift Step 👟, for your thumbs' sake
Tap the 🎃 in the corner to access settings, where you can toggle "👻 Character Visibility"
Clearing a level refreshes fireworks in most modes
Candy is NEVER on a trap
Make a new save file to try 😱 hard mode
When you're not sure, use fireworks to clear a path
Skip levels to take advantage of candy multipliers
You can toggle off abilities in the shop, so feel free to buy and experiment
Unlock Reaper's Run for $2 for surprisingly fun single-run challenges where you can try out new abilities
Share your scores with your friends in text threads and social media using the share button
